title: GlaxoSmithKline – consolidated balance sheet 2018 (exam 2019, described)
text: GSK presents its balance sheet in this order: non-current assets, current assets, current liabilities, non-current liabilities. Liabilities are shown in brackets as negative numbers, leading to a subtotal 'net assets', below which the detailed composition of total equity is presented (share capital, share premium, retained earnings, other reserves, shareholders' equity, non-controlling interests).
In 2018 the line 'non-controlling interests' is negative.
